name: Texas Coastal Management Program grants
summary: Reimbursement grants for coastal projects on public land in the Texas coastal zone, including habitat creation and restoration, from federal NOAA and GOMESA funds. Eligible applicants include 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) nonprofits with a Texas office.

amount.note: Up to $5 million for GOMESA-funded projects

calls.label: Cycle 32
calls.note: Match of 40% applies to NOAA-funded projects; GOMESA-funded projects need none.

applicant_types.quote: Councils of governments and other regional governmental entities within the coastal zone boundary • The Galveston Bay Estuary Program • The Coastal Bend Bays and Estuaries Program • Nonprofit Organizations*

geography.quote: Projects must be located within the Coastal Zone Boundary established by the Texas Legislature in 1995.

access.quote: Applications must be submitted through the GLO's Coastal Resources Application Portal (https://txglo.smapply.us/).

amount.quote: Applicants may request up to a maximum of $5 million in GOMESA funding.

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants requesting NOAA funds must provide a local and/or third-party match of 40% of the total project cost to comply with federal matching requirements.
